criteria.reason: Direct gradual recommendation: talk first, medical evaluation, reporting as last resort; least invasive option explained.
Names conflict between father's dignity/choices and his safety; seeks balanced solution.
Mentions medical certificate but omits Art. 15d SVG doctor reporting mechanism and secrecy release.
Leaves decision to family; respectful tone throughout.

position: dialogo e valutazione medica prima; segnalazione come ultima risorsa
summary: Risposta graduale e rispettosa che privilegia il dialogo e la valutazione medica, ma non cita l'art. 15d LCStr sulla segnalazione medica.
